# [Implementation] - Task Plan

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #311 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Each check runs from the repository root (worktree root) and builds first so `dist/` is
current. Checks 2–4 create throwaway checkpoints under the tool's own sanctioned smoke sandbox
(`$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-311-*`, the only path the storage guard permits state mutation in),
run the CLI with `env -u AGY_SUBAGENT` (a dispatched agent's harness may set it, and
`gate-report`/`transition` refuse to run inside a subagent session), and delete the sandbox via
an `EXIT` trap. None of them touch this repository's `.agyloop/` state.

#### Check 1 — the no-protocol prompt's own example parses as `NOT_DECLARED`

```bash
npm run build >/dev/null
node - <<'NODE'
const { ResolveSubagentUseCase } = require('./dist/application');
const {
  GateResultReport,
  GATE_REPORT_JSON_MARKER,
  SMOKE_PROTOCOL_VOCABULARY
} = require('./dist/domain');
const configRepo = {
  loadConfig: () => ({}),
  resolveModel: (role) => ({ role, configured: 'flash', tier: 'flash', apiModel: 'gemini-2.5-flash' }),
  mapModelToTier: () => 'flash'
};
const prompt = new ResolveSubagentUseCase(configRepo).buildGateTaskPrompt({
  issueNumber: 311,
  commands: ['npm test'],
  cwd: process.cwd()
});
const marker = prompt.lastIndexOf(GATE_REPORT_JSON_MARKER);
if (marker < 0) throw new Error('FAIL: the gate prompt emits no GATE_REPORT_JSON example');
const report = GateResultReport.parseBlock(prompt.slice(marker), 1);
if (report.smokeProtocol !== 'NOT_DECLARED') {
  throw new Error(`FAIL: the emitted example says ${report.smokeProtocol}`);
}
if (prompt.includes('NOT DECLARED')) {
  throw new Error('FAIL: the prompt still emits the spaced token');
}
if (!prompt.includes(`- Smoke Protocol: ${SMOKE_PROTOCOL_VOCABULARY}`)) {
  throw new Error('FAIL: the verdict list is not the parser vocabulary');
}
console.log('S1 PASS: example parses as', report.smokeProtocol);
NODE
```

#### Check 2 — filing at REVIEW is refused, nothing written, no `Next:` line

```bash
npm run build >/dev/null
ROOT="$PWD"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
WS="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-311-review-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$WS"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$WS/.agyloop/tasks"
git -C "$WS" init -q
git -C "$WS" -c user.email=smoke@test -c user.name=smoke commit --allow-empty -qm init
node - "$WS" <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const ws = process.argv[2];
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(ws, '.agyloop', 'tasks', '311.json'),
  JSON.stringify(
    {
      version: '1.0.0',
      currentStage: 'REVIEW',
      mode: 'standard',
      issue: 311,
      baseBranch: 'main',
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      history: [
        { stage: 'IMPLEMENT', timestamp: now },
        { stage: 'QUALITY_GATE', timestamp: now },
        { stage: 'REVIEW', timestamp: now }
      ],
      pausedAtGate: null,
      pausedAtTimestamp: null,
      totalHumanWaitMs: 0
    },
    null,
    2
  )
);
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(ws, 'gate.json'),
  [
    'GATE_REPORT_JSON:',
    '{ "verdict": "PASSED", "buildSystem": "npm", "buildStatus": "PASSED",',
    '  "testsStatus": "PASSED (1 passed)", "testsPassed": 1, "testsFailed": 0,',
    '  "durationMs": 1, "executedCommands": ["npm test"], "smokeProtocol": "NOT_DECLARED", "notRun": [] }'
  ].join('\n')
);
NODE
CODE=0
OUT="$(cd "$WS" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" gate-report --issue 311 --report-file gate.json 2>&1)" || CODE=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
if [ "$CODE" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "FAIL: filing at REVIEW must exit 1, got $CODE"
  exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'QUALITY_GATE'; then
  echo "FAIL: the refusal must name QUALITY_GATE as the legal stage"
  exit 1
fi
if printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Next:'; then
  echo "FAIL: gate-report advised a next step at REVIEW"
  exit 1
fi
if [ -f "$WS/.agyloop/tasks/311.gate.json" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: a refused filing must write no evidence file"
  exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$WS"
echo "S2 PASS: REVIEW filing refused, nothing written, no Next line"
```

#### Check 3 — at QUALITY_GATE the printed `Next:` command is legal and consumes the evidence

```bash
npm run build >/dev/null
ROOT="$PWD"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
WS="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-311-qg-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$WS"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$WS/.agyloop/tasks"
git -C "$WS" init -q
git -C "$WS" -c user.email=smoke@test -c user.name=smoke commit --allow-empty -qm init
node - "$WS" <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const ws = process.argv[2];
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(ws, '.agyloop', 'tasks', '311.json'),
  JSON.stringify(
    {
      version: '1.0.0',
      currentStage: 'QUALITY_GATE',
      mode: 'standard',
      issue: 311,
      baseBranch: 'main',
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      history: [
        { stage: 'IMPLEMENT', timestamp: now },
        { stage: 'QUALITY_GATE', timestamp: now }
      ],
      pausedAtGate: null,
      pausedAtTimestamp: null,
      totalHumanWaitMs: 0
    },
    null,
    2
  )
);
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(ws, 'gate.json'),
  [
    'GATE_REPORT_JSON:',
    '{ "verdict": "PASSED", "buildSystem": "npm", "buildStatus": "PASSED",',
    '  "testsStatus": "PASSED (1 passed)", "testsPassed": 1, "testsFailed": 0,',
    '  "durationMs": 1, "executedCommands": ["npm test"], "smokeProtocol": "NOT_DECLARED", "notRun": [] }'
  ].join('\n')
);
NODE
CODE=0
OUT="$(cd "$WS" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" gate-report --issue 311 --report-file gate.json 2>&1)" || CODE=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
if [ "$CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL: filing at QUALITY_GATE must exit 0, got $CODE"
  exit 1
fi
if ! printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Next: codeloop transition REVIEW --issue 311'; then
  echo "FAIL: the printed Next line is not the legal transition REVIEW"
  exit 1
fi
NEXT="$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^  Next: //p')"
ARGS="${NEXT#codeloop }"
CODE=0
OUT2="$(cd "$WS" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" $ARGS 2>&1)" || CODE=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT2"
if [ "$CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL: the Next command it printed is not legal, exit $CODE"
  exit 1
fi
if ! node -e "const s = require(process.argv[1]); process.exit(s.currentStage === 'REVIEW' ? 0 : 1);" "$WS/.agyloop/tasks/311.json"; then
  echo "FAIL: following the printed command did not reach REVIEW"
  exit 1
fi
if [ -f "$WS/.agyloop/tasks/311.gate.json" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: the ingested evidence must be consumed"
  exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$WS"
echo "S3 PASS: the printed transition is legal and consumes the evidence"
```

#### Check 4 — one round formula: a count-0 checkpoint files and ingests round 1

```bash
npm run build >/dev/null
ROOT="$PWD"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
WS="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-311-round-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$WS"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$WS/.agyloop/tasks"
git -C "$WS" init -q
git -C "$WS" -c user.email=smoke@test -c user.name=smoke commit --allow-empty -qm init
node - "$WS" <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const ws = process.argv[2];
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(ws, '.agyloop', 'tasks', '311.json'),
  JSON.stringify(
    {
      version: '1.0.0',
      currentStage: 'QUALITY_GATE',
      mode: 'standard',
      issue: 311,
      baseBranch: 'main',
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      history: [{ stage: 'IMPLEMENT', timestamp: now }],
      pausedAtGate: null,
      pausedAtTimestamp: null,
      totalHumanWaitMs: 0
    },
    null,
    2
  )
);
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(ws, 'gate.json'),
  [
    'GATE_REPORT_JSON:',
    '{ "verdict": "PASSED", "buildSystem": "npm", "buildStatus": "PASSED",',
    '  "testsStatus": "PASSED (1 passed)", "testsPassed": 1, "testsFailed": 0,',
    '  "durationMs": 1, "executedCommands": ["npm test"], "smokeProtocol": "NOT_DECLARED", "notRun": [] }'
  ].join('\n')
);
NODE
CODE=0
OUT="$(cd "$WS" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" gate-report --issue 311 --report-file gate.json 2>&1)" || CODE=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
if [ "$CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL: filing at QUALITY_GATE must exit 0, got $CODE"
  exit 1
fi
if ! node -e "const s = require(process.argv[1]); process.exit(s.gateRound === 1 ? 0 : 1);" "$WS/.agyloop/tasks/311.gate.json"; then
  echo "FAIL: a count-0 checkpoint must file round 1"
  exit 1
fi
CODE=0
OUT2="$(cd "$WS" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition REVIEW --issue 311 2>&1)" || CODE=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT2"
if [ "$CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL: transition REVIEW must exit 0, got $CODE"
  exit 1
fi
if printf '%s' "$OUT2" | grep -q 'no gate evidence'; then
  echo "FAIL: ingest discarded a freshly filed round-1 report"
  exit 1
fi
if ! node -e "const s = require(process.argv[1]); const last = s.history[s.history.length - 1]; process.exit(last.stage === 'REVIEW' && last.metadata.gateVerdict === 'PASSED' ? 0 : 1);" "$WS/.agyloop/tasks/311.json"; then
  echo "FAIL: the ingested checkpoint must carry gateVerdict PASSED"
  exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$WS"
echo "S4 PASS: filing and ingest agree on round 1"
```
